glosses: Se dit d’un gardien de but qui fait preuve de peu d’adresse pour arrêter les tirs adverses.

glosses: A device with a mesh, grate, or otherwise perforated bottom to separate, in a granular material, larger particles from smaller ones, or to separate solid objects from a liquid.

glosses: A process, physical or abstract, that arrives at a final result by filtering out unwanted pieces of input from a larger starting set of input.

examples.text: Given a list of consecutive numbers starting at 1, the Sieve of Eratosthenes algorithm will find all of the prime numbers.
